links.outcome: Criterion-level agreement between TRIAGE and CRC adjudication, with structured readjudication of discordances
links.effect: 93.1% raw agreement across 1,770 adjudications, improving to 94.2% after structured readjudication; 10 of 25 (40%) initial CRC discordances overturned in favor of TRIAGE.
links.quote: Criterion-level evaluation across 1,770 adjudications showed 93.1% raw agreement, improving to 94.2% after structured readjudication; 10 of 25 (40%) initial CRC discordances were overturned in favor of TRIAGE.

links.outcome: Trial-level sensitivity, specificity, PPV, NPV at predefined and lower decision thresholds
links.effect: At threshold 0.40: sensitivity 78.3%, specificity 98.5%, PPV 92.6%, NPV 94.8%. At 0.13: sensitivity 98.7%, specificity 97.6%, PPV 91.2%, NPV 99.7%.
links.quote: A lower threshold (0.13) maximized sensitivity (98.7%), while maintaining high specificity at 97.6%, PPV at 91.2%, and NPV at 99.7%.

links.outcome: Performance against expert reference standard on real-world EHR data
links.effect: At predefined threshold 0.40, sensitivity 78.3%, specificity 98.5%, PPV 92.6%, NPV 94.8% on held-out test set with CRC adjudication.
links.quote: At the predefined trial-level decision threshold for eligibility (0.40), the sensitivity was 78.3%, the specificity was 98.5%, the PPV was 92.6%, and the NPV was 94.8%.
